limits: One entry per full transaction hash. Ethereum block hashes, PoolIds, unsigned simulation hashes and unverified short prefixes are excluded.
Ledger denominators overlap. Cohorts must not be summed and screen-only rows do not count as independently audited.
Shape describes witnessed funding layout, not venue labels, attacker intent, strategy edge or net profit.
Event counts, raw equal-amount proxies, strict market-swap depth, hybrid state transitions and partial split layers use separate fields.
Native receipts and direct payments are observed scope. Unpriced inventory, common control, external payments and implicit costs can remain unresolved.
